keyframes.framing: Angled view over a workshop table: a large round copper relief disc with wave carving sits center, and a flat foreground panel carries a row of tally counting marks above a row of open-hand-and-droplet water-sharing symbols, with hand tools scattered around.
keyframes.knownDefects: The relief is a single round disc rather than three joined fragments, and the counting marks / hand-water symbols sit on a separate foreground slab instead of on the fragments; an unnamed teal-robed woman who appears in no prompt sits at frame right.

keyframes.framing: Under a thatched workshop shelter, a younger dark-haired engineer in a blue tunic and tool belt and an older bearded worker in khaki work clothes jointly hold a clay cup of water between them, with baskets, jars, tools and hanging lanterns around.
keyframes.knownDefects: The handoff direction is ambiguous — both men grip the cup together, so who gives and who receives is unclear; modern open-end wrenches hang in the tool rack at frame left and read anachronistic; the younger man's expression reads anxious rather than tired and sincere. (No mechanical back frame on either figure, as required.)

keyframes.framing: A medium two-shot in a ruined courtyard: a topknotted man in an olive tunic (Ha Mac) sits at left holding a brush over an open gridded notebook, a teal-robed woman sits beside him, and a large cracked stone relief wall with geometric carvings fills the background.
keyframes.knownDefects: Framing is a medium two-shot instead of the detail close view of relief and brush; the relief is cracked stone in the background, not the copper relief of S01 (material continuity break), and the brush hovers over the notebook rather than over the chisel scars; the same unnamed teal-robed woman from S01 — in no prompt — sits smiling beside Ha Mac.
